# AGENTS.md

Hand-written static site for georgedreemer.com (HTML/CSS/JS + PHP shell, cPanel behind Cloudflare). No framework. Keep changes small and reviewable.

## Commands (repository root)
- Everything: `bash scripts/build-all.sh`
- Markdown twins + manifest: `bash scripts/build-markdown.sh` (`--check` to verify freshness)
- llms.txt + llms-full.txt + deploy snippets: `python3 scripts/build-llms.py`
- Schema check / repair / publish: `python3 scripts/schema.py` (`--fix`, `--embed`, `--write`)
- cv.json, faq.md, this file: `python3 scripts/build-agent-files.py`
- Tests: `.venv-markdown/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests`

## Source of truth
- Page content: `dev_html/**/*.html` (edit these).
- Structured data: `seo/schema/<page>_schema.json` (edit these, then `schema.py --embed --write`; never edit the JSON-LD inside the HTML).
- AI guide: `seo/llms.txt` (hand-written).
- Generated, never edit by hand: `build/markdown/*`, `build/agent/*`, `build/reports/*`.

Pages:
- `dev_html/education/bachelors.html` -> `education/bachelors.md`
- `dev_html/education/masters.html` -> `education/masters.md`
- `dev_html/index.html` -> `index.md`
- `dev_html/work/cryptopandemic.html` -> `work/cryptopandemic.md`
- `dev_html/work/datasafari.html` -> `work/datasafari.md`
- `dev_html/work/dreemcorp.html` -> `work/dreemcorp.md`
- `dev_html/work/skipschoolmakemoney.html` -> `work/skipschoolmakemoney.md`
- `dev_html/work/thoughtbubble.html` -> `work/thoughtbubble.md`

## Rules
- One `<h1>` per page inside `<main>`; real heading levels; lists as `<ul><li>`; label/value pairs as `<dl>`.
- Never write dates (years or month names) in site prose. `build-llms.py` fails on them in llms.txt; the other builds flag them. Private details (contact, salary, visa, employment dates) never go into public files.
- Every number or claim on a page is the owner's own and is treated as fact; do not rewrite or "improve" claims.
- Run `bash scripts/build-all.sh` before every commit; commit sources and generated files together.
- `public_html/` is a server mirror synced by `scripts/cpanel-sync.sh` (it pulls with `--delete`; never generate into it).

## Data contract for assistants and job-search agents
- Read in this order: `build/agent/cv.json` -> `build/agent/faq.md` -> `build/markdown/llms-full.txt` -> single page `.md` for detail.
- The BA GPA is an estimate (`education[].x-score-note`); always say "estimated".
- Ventures are founder/creator roles, not employment. Employment dates, contact details, compensation, visa and relocation status are NOT in these files: take them from the private CV file or ask the owner. Never infer them.
- Prefer the owner's wording from `summary`, `highlights` and `x-abilities`; quote metrics exactly as written.
